nodes.description: Mapping address=>uint256 of depositor balances; written in Deposit, read and written in Collect.
Minimum balance threshold (1 ether) required to withdraw; set once via SetMinSum before Initialized().
External LogFile contract reference; set once via SetLogFile before Initialized().
Initialization lock flag; gates SetMinSum and SetLogFile and is set to true by Initialized().
Public array of Message structs; appended to in AddMessage.
Storage Message struct written field-by-field in AddMessage before being pushed to History.
Public function that sets MinSum; only callable while intitalized is false.
Public function that sets the Log contract address; only callable while intitalized is false.
Public function that permanently sets intitalized to true, locking configuration.
Payable deposit that credits balances[msg.sender] with msg.value and calls Log.AddMessage.
Payable withdrawal that sends ether with msg.sender.call.value(_am)() before decreasing balances[msg.sender] (classic reentrancy pattern).
Fallback function that forwards to Deposit().
External logging function that stores a Message with sender, value, data and current timestamp.
Caller-controlled address used as balance key and as the target of the ether transfer in Collect.
now, used as LastMsg.Time in AddMessage (timestamp dependence).
msg.sender.call.value(_am)() low-level ether transfer performed before the balance is decremented.
New minimum-sum value assigned into MinSum.
Address cast to LogFile and stored in Log.
Withdrawal amount, checked against balances and forwarded to the external call.
Sender address stored into LastMsg.Sender.
Value stored into LastMsg.Val.
String stored into LastMsg.Data.

edges.reason: Parameter _val is consumed by SetMinSum.
Parameter _log is consumed by SetLogFile.
Parameter _am is consumed by Collect for both the check and the transfer.
Parameter _adr is consumed by AddMessage.
Parameter _val is consumed by AddMessage.
Parameter _data is consumed by AddMessage.
SetMinSum writes MinSum.
SetLogFile writes the Log contract reference.
Initialized sets intitalized to true.
Deposit increases balances[msg.sender] by msg.value.
Collect decreases balances[msg.sender] after the external call.
AddMessage writes fields of LastMsg.
AddMessage pushes LastMsg into History.
AddMessage records now in LastMsg.Time, creating timestamp dependence.
Deposit keys state updates on caller-controlled msg.sender.
Collect uses caller-controlled msg.sender as both balance key and transfer target.
The low-level call sends ether to the caller-controlled address.
balances[msg.sender] is updated only after the external call returns, enabling reentrant drain.
The external call is executed inside Collect when the balance checks pass.
The fallback function forwards execution to Deposit.
Deposit performs an external call into LogFile.AddMessage.
Collect performs an external call into LogFile.AddMessage after the transfer.
intitalized guards SetMinSum with a revert.
intitalized guards SetLogFile with a revert.
Collect reads MinSum as the withdrawal threshold.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter _val has no independent security meaning; it is only the argument written into MinSum by SetMinSum and should be normalized into that core function.
The parameter _log is only an argument used by SetLogFile to assign the Log state variable and should be merged into that function.
The parameter _am is only used inside Collect for the balance check and the external transfer, so it should be collapsed into the Collect function node.
The parameter _adr is only assigned to LastMsg.Sender inside AddMessage and should be normalized into that core function.
The parameter _val is only assigned to LastMsg.Val inside AddMessage and should be normalized into that core function.
The parameter _data is only assigned to LastMsg.Data inside AddMessage and should be normalized into that core function.
